materials.direction: 大学应该免费吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 消除经济障碍 → 寒门子弟也能读大学 → 缩小贫富差距、促进阶层流动
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Remove financial barriers → students from poor families can attend university → narrow the wealth gap and promote social mobility
materials.example: 北欧国家（瑞典、挪威）免学费，社会流动性指标全球领先
materials.example_en: Nordic countries (Sweden, Norway) charge no tuition, and their social mobility indices lead the world
materials.topic_sentence: 免费大学教育有助于促进社会公平。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Free university education helps promote social equality.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"谁受益"（穷人=公平、国家=发展）；反方想"谁受损"（政府钱包=财政、学生自己=动力）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Removing financial barriers enables students from poor families to attend university, which in turn narrows the wealth gap and promotes social mobility.

materials.direction: 大学应该免费吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 更多人接受高等教育 → 劳动力素质整体提升 → 推动科技创新和经济增长
materials.reasoning_chain_en: More people receive higher education → overall workforce quality improves → drives technological innovation and economic growth
materials.example: 德国免学费后STEM专业毕业生持续增长，制造业竞争力增强
materials.example_en: After Germany abolished tuition fees, STEM graduates grew steadily and manufacturing competitiveness strengthened
materials.topic_sentence: 免费高等教育能有力推动国家经济发展。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Free higher education can significantly boost national economic development.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"谁受益"（穷人=公平、国家=发展）；反方想"谁受损"（政府钱包=财政、学生自己=动力）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When more people receive higher education, the overall quality of the workforce improves, driving technological innovation and economic growth.

materials.direction: 大学应该免费吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 政府预算有限 → 免学费挤占医疗/基建支出 → 其他公共服务质量下降
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Government budgets are limited → free tuition diverts funds from healthcare/infrastructure → quality of other public services declines
materials.example: 英国部分地方政府因教育开支激增，被迫削减NHS医疗预算和社区服务拨款
materials.example_en: Some UK local governments were forced to cut NHS healthcare budgets and community service funding due to surging education spending
materials.topic_sentence: 免费大学教育会给政府财政带来沉重负担。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Free university education would place an unsustainable burden on government finances.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"谁受益"（穷人=公平、国家=发展）；反方想"谁受损"（政府钱包=财政、学生自己=动力）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Since government budgets are limited, making tuition free would divert funds from healthcare and infrastructure, causing the quality of other public services to decline.

materials.direction: 大学应该免费吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 免费意味着学生没有经济投入 → 没有沉没成本就容易不珍惜机会 → 辍学率上升、学习态度松懈
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Free means no financial investment by students → without sunk costs they are less likely to value the opportunity → dropout rates rise and study attitudes become lax
materials.example: 对比数据显示收费制大学毕业率普遍高于免费制大学
materials.example_en: Comparative data show that tuition-charging universities generally have higher graduation rates than tuition-free ones
materials.topic_sentence: 免费教育可能削弱学生的学习动力。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Free education may undermine students' motivation to learn.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"谁受益"（穷人=公平、国家=发展）；反方想"谁受损"（政府钱包=财政、学生自己=动力）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When education is free, students have no financial investment in their studies, which means they are less likely to value the opportunity, leading to higher dropout rates and lax study attitudes.

materials.direction: 网课能否取代传统课堂？
materials.reasoning_chain: 不受时间地点限制 → 学生可在最高效的时间段学习 → 兼顾工作/家庭的同时完成学业
materials.reasoning_chain_en: No constraints of time or location → students can study during their most productive hours → enabling them to complete their studies while balancing work and family
materials.example: 上班族利用通勤/深夜时间在Coursera完成学位课程，传统大学做不到
materials.example_en: Working adults complete degree courses on Coursera during commutes or late at night, which would be impossible with traditional universities
materials.topic_sentence: 网络课程为学生提供了无可比拟的学习灵活性。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Online courses offer students unmatched learning flexibility.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"网课的优势"（随时随地=灵活、人人可学=平等）；反方想"屏幕的代价"（管不住自己=效果差、没有同学=社交缺失）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Without the constraints of a fixed schedule or location, students can study during their most productive hours, enabling them to complete their studies while balancing work and family responsibilities.

materials.direction: 网课能否取代传统课堂？
materials.reasoning_chain: 优质课程可无限复制传播 → 偏远地区学生也能获取名师资源 → 教育资源地区差距因此缩小
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Quality courses can be replicated and distributed without limit → students in remote areas gain access to top teachers → regional gaps in educational resources are narrowed
materials.example: 中国「双师课堂」模式让农村学生听到城市名校教师授课
materials.example_en: China's 'dual-teacher classroom' model lets rural students attend lessons taught by top urban school teachers
materials.topic_sentence: 网课能有效缩小教育资源的地区差距。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Online learning can effectively narrow regional gaps in educational resources.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"网课的优势"（随时随地=灵活、人人可学=平等）；反方想"屏幕的代价"（管不住自己=效果差、没有同学=社交缺失）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Because quality courses can be replicated and distributed without limit, students in remote areas gain access to top teachers, effectively narrowing regional gaps in educational resources.

materials.direction: 网课能否取代传统课堂？
materials.reasoning_chain: 缺乏面对面监督 → 自制力不足的学生容易分心 → 完课率和学习深度远低于线下
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Lack of face-to-face supervision → students with poor self-discipline are easily distracted → completion rates and learning depth are far lower than offline
materials.example: 数据显示MOOC平均完课率不到10%，远低于传统大学
materials.example_en: Data show that the average MOOC completion rate is below 10%, far lower than traditional universities
materials.topic_sentence: 网课的学习效果明显不如传统课堂。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Online learning is significantly less effective than traditional classroom instruction.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"网课的优势"（随时随地=灵活、人人可学=平等）；反方想"屏幕的代价"（管不住自己=效果差、没有同学=社交缺失）
materials.chain_sentence_en: The lack of face-to-face supervision means that students with poor self-discipline are easily distracted, resulting in completion rates and learning depth far lower than those of offline courses.

materials.direction: 网课能否取代传统课堂？
materials.reasoning_chain: 校园是社交场所 → 网课剥夺了同伴互动机会 → 学生的社交技能和心理健康受损
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Campus is a social environment → online classes deprive students of peer interaction → students' social skills and mental health suffer
materials.example: 疫情期间长期网课导致青少年孤独感和心理问题显著上升
materials.example_en: Prolonged online learning during the pandemic led to a significant rise in adolescent loneliness and mental health issues
materials.topic_sentence: 网课不利于学生社交能力的发展。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Online learning hinders the development of students' social skills.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"网课的优势"（随时随地=灵活、人人可学=平等）；反方想"屏幕的代价"（管不住自己=效果差、没有同学=社交缺失）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Since campus serves as a social environment, online classes deprive students of peer interaction, which damages their social skills and mental health.

materials.direction: 教育应该注重竞争还是合作？
materials.reasoning_chain: 排名/考试压力 → 激励学生更加努力 → 挖掘个人最大潜力
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Rankings and exam pressure → motivate students to work harder → helping them unlock their full potential
materials.example: 新加坡精英教育体制培养出大量高素质人才，国际学术排名领先
materials.example_en: Singapore's elite education system produces large numbers of high-calibre graduates and leads international academic rankings
materials.topic_sentence: 适度竞争有助于激发学生的个人潜能。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Healthy competition helps students reach their full potential.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"竞争的好处"（逼出潜力=个人、适应社会=职场）；反方想"竞争的坏处"（压力大=心理、实际工作靠团队=需求）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Rankings and exam pressure motivate students to work harder, helping them unlock their full potential.

materials.direction: 教育应该注重竞争还是合作？
materials.reasoning_chain: 职场本质是竞争环境 → 学校培养竞争意识 → 学生毕业后适应力更强
materials.reasoning_chain_en: The workplace is inherently competitive → schools that foster a competitive mindset prepare students for this reality → producing graduates who adapt to professional environments more quickly
materials.example: 许多企业HR反映，缺乏竞争经验的毕业生进入职场后难以承受绩效考核压力，试用期离职率明显偏高
materials.example_en: Many HR managers report that graduates lacking competitive experience struggle with performance reviews and have notably higher resignation rates during probation
materials.topic_sentence: 竞争教育能帮助学生更好地适应职场。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Competitive education better prepares students for the workplace.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"竞争的好处"（逼出潜力=个人、适应社会=职场）；反方想"竞争的坏处"（压力大=心理、实际工作靠团队=需求）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Because the workplace is inherently competitive, schools that foster a competitive mindset prepare students for this reality, producing graduates who adapt to professional environments more quickly.

materials.direction: 教育应该注重竞争还是合作？
materials.reasoning_chain: 过度竞争 → 焦虑和自我否定 → 厌学甚至心理疾病
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Excessive competition → anxiety and self-doubt → aversion to learning or even mental illness
materials.example: 韩国/日本学生因升学压力导致的心理问题和自杀率数据
materials.example_en: In South Korea and Japan, intense academic pressure has led to alarming rates of student mental health problems and suicide.
materials.topic_sentence: 过度竞争严重损害学生的心理健康。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Excessive competition seriously harms students' mental health.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"竞争的好处"（逼出潜力=个人、适应社会=职场）；反方想"竞争的坏处"（压力大=心理、实际工作靠团队=需求）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Excessive competition breeds anxiety and self-doubt among students, which can escalate into an aversion to learning or even serious mental illness.

materials.direction: 教育应该注重竞争还是合作？
materials.reasoning_chain: 现代工作以团队项目为主 → 合作能力比个人成绩更重要 → 只强调竞争的学生进入职场后难以融入团队、影响职业发展
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Modern work revolves around team projects → collaborative skills matter more than individual grades → students trained only in competition struggle to work in teams, which ultimately hinders their professional growth
materials.example: Google等科技公司招聘最看重团队协作能力而非个人分数
materials.example_en: Tech companies like Google prioritise teamwork skills over individual grades when hiring
materials.topic_sentence: 合作能力比竞争意识对职业发展更为重要。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Collaborative skills are more important than competitiveness for career success.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"竞争的好处"（逼出潜力=个人、适应社会=职场）；反方想"竞争的坏处"（压力大=心理、实际工作靠团队=需求）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Modern work revolves around team projects where collaborative skills matter more than individual grades; consequently, students trained only in competition struggle to work in teams, which ultimately hinders their professional growth.

materials.direction: 社交媒体利大于弊还是弊大于利？
materials.reasoning_chain: 打破地理限制 → 维系远距离关系/认识志同道合的人 → 减少孤独感、扩大社交圈
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Break geographical barriers → maintain long-distance relationships and meet like-minded people → reduce loneliness and expand social circles
materials.example: 疫情期间社交媒体成为人们维持社交的主要方式，缓解了隔离带来的孤独
materials.example_en: During the pandemic, social media became the main way people maintained social contact, alleviating isolation-induced loneliness
materials.topic_sentence: 社交媒体有效促进了人际连接。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Social media effectively strengthens interpersonal connections.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"连接"（连接人=社交、连接机会=创业）；反方想"毒害"（毒害心理=抑郁、毒害信息=假新闻）
materials.chain_sentence_en: By breaking geographical barriers, social media helps people maintain long-distance relationships and meet like-minded individuals, thereby reducing loneliness and expanding their social circles.

materials.direction: 社交媒体利大于弊还是弊大于利？
materials.reasoning_chain: 信息传播极快 → 普通人也能获得曝光和商业机会 → 催生了自媒体经济和小微创业
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Information spreads extremely fast → ordinary people can gain exposure and business opportunities → giving rise to the creator economy and micro-entrepreneurship
materials.example: 大量年轻人通过Instagram/抖音创业成功，无需传统资本门槛
materials.example_en: Many young people have built successful businesses through Instagram/TikTok without traditional capital barriers
materials.topic_sentence: 社交媒体为普通人创造了前所未有的机会。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Social media creates unprecedented opportunities for ordinary people.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"连接"（连接人=社交、连接机会=创业）；反方想"毒害"（毒害心理=抑郁、毒害信息=假新闻）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Information spreads extremely fast on social media, enabling ordinary people to gain exposure and business opportunities, which has given rise to the creator economy and micro-entrepreneurship.

materials.direction: 社交媒体利大于弊还是弊大于利？
materials.reasoning_chain: 算法推送极端内容 → 用户沉迷/焦虑/社交比较 → 抑郁和自我认同问题增加
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Algorithms push extreme content → users become addicted, anxious, and engage in social comparison → depression and identity issues increase
materials.example: Instagram的「点赞」和「滤镜美颜」功能导致青少年不断与理想化形象对比，引发严重的外貌焦虑和饮食障碍
materials.example_en: Instagram's 'like' counts and beauty filters cause teenagers to constantly compare themselves with idealised images, triggering severe body anxiety and eating disorders
materials.topic_sentence: 社交媒体严重威胁用户的心理健康。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Social media poses a serious threat to users' mental health.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"连接"（连接人=社交、连接机会=创业）；反方想"毒害"（毒害心理=抑郁、毒害信息=假新闻）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Algorithms push extreme content that causes users to become addicted and engage in social comparison, which increases the prevalence of depression and identity issues.

materials.direction: 社交媒体利大于弊还是弊大于利？
materials.reasoning_chain: 假新闻传播速度远超辟谣 → 公众被大量真假混杂的信息淹没、难以分辨 → 社会信任被侵蚀、舆论极化
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Fake news spreads far faster than corrections → the public is flooded with mixed true and false information and cannot tell them apart → social trust is eroded and public opinion polarises
materials.example: 美国大选/疫情期间大量虚假信息通过Facebook传播，造成严重社会分裂
materials.example_en: During U.S. elections and the pandemic, massive misinformation spread via Facebook, causing serious social division
materials.topic_sentence: 社交媒体加速了虚假信息的传播，侵蚀社会信任。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Social media accelerates the spread of misinformation and erodes public trust.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"连接"（连接人=社交、连接机会=创业）；反方想"毒害"（毒害心理=抑郁、毒害信息=假新闻）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Fake news spreads far faster than corrections, leaving the public flooded with mixed true and false information that they cannot tell apart, which erodes social trust and polarises public opinion.

materials.direction: AI会取代人类工作吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: AI自动化 → 重复性岗位大量消失 → 低技能劳动者失业且难以转型
materials.reasoning_chain_en: AI automation → massive loss of repetitive jobs → low-skilled workers become unemployed and struggle to retrain
materials.example: 自动驾驶技术威胁全球数百万卡车司机/出租车司机的生计
materials.example_en: Self-driving technology threatens the livelihoods of millions of truck and taxi drivers worldwide
materials.topic_sentence: 人工智能的发展可能导致大规模失业。
materials.topic_sentence_en: The development of AI may lead to mass unemployment.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"AI抢走了什么"（抢工作=失业、抢财富=不平等）；反方想"人类怎么赢"（历史证明=新岗位、人与AI合作=工作升级）
materials.chain_sentence_en: AI automation eliminates massive numbers of repetitive jobs, leaving low-skilled workers unemployed and struggling to retrain for new roles.

materials.direction: AI会取代人类工作吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: AI自动化取代大量岗位 → 普通劳动者议价能力下降、收入减少 → 而AI利润集中在科技公司和资本持有者手中 → 贫富差距进一步扩大
materials.reasoning_chain_en: AI automation replaces many jobs → ordinary workers lose bargaining power and their income falls → while AI profits concentrate among tech companies and capital owners → the wealth gap widens further
materials.example: 全球前10大科技公司市值暴涨，同期中产阶级收入增长停滞
materials.example_en: The market value of the world's top 10 tech companies has soared while middle-class income growth has stagnated over the same period
materials.topic_sentence: 人工智能可能进一步加剧社会贫富分化。
materials.topic_sentence_en: AI may further widen the gap between the rich and the poor.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"AI抢走了什么"（抢工作=失业、抢财富=不平等）；反方想"人类怎么赢"（历史证明=新岗位、人与AI合作=工作升级）
materials.chain_sentence_en: As AI automation replaces many jobs, ordinary workers lose bargaining power and their income falls, while profits concentrate among tech companies and capital owners, further widening the wealth gap.

materials.direction: AI会取代人类工作吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 每次技术革命都淘汰旧岗位但创造更多新岗位 → 人类通过学习新技能实现了转型 → AI时代同样会催生大量目前无法想象的新职业
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Every technological revolution has eliminated old jobs but created even more new ones → humans adapted by learning new skills → the AI era will likewise spawn many new professions we cannot yet imagine
materials.example: 工业革命淘汰了手工织布，但创造了更多工厂管理和工程岗位
materials.example_en: The Industrial Revolution eliminated hand-weaving, but created far more factory management and engineering jobs
materials.topic_sentence: 人工智能将创造更多新就业机会而非导致失业。
materials.topic_sentence_en: AI will create more new jobs rather than cause mass unemployment.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"AI抢走了什么"（抢工作=失业、抢财富=不平等）；反方想"人类怎么赢"（历史证明=新岗位、人与AI合作=工作升级）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Every technological revolution has eliminated old jobs but created even more new ones, as humans have consistently adapted by learning new skills; the AI era will likewise spawn many professions we cannot yet imagine.

materials.direction: AI会取代人类工作吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: AI接管重复性劳动 → 人类得以转向创意/情感/决策类工作 → 工作内容更有意义，职业满意度和产出质量提升
materials.reasoning_chain_en: AI takes over repetitive labour → humans shift to creative, emotional, and decision-making work → job content becomes more meaningful, and job satisfaction and output quality improve
materials.example: 会计师从繁琐的记账工作中解放出来，转而为客户提供财务战略咨询，工作满意度和收入均提升
materials.example_en: Accountants are freed from tedious bookkeeping and instead provide clients with financial strategy consulting, improving both job satisfaction and income
materials.topic_sentence: 人工智能能提升人类工作的质量和价值。
materials.topic_sentence_en: AI can improve the quality and value of human work.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"AI抢走了什么"（抢工作=失业、抢财富=不平等）；反方想"人类怎么赢"（历史证明=新岗位、人与AI合作=工作升级）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When AI takes over repetitive labour, humans can shift to creative, emotional, and decision-making work, making job content more meaningful and improving both job satisfaction and output quality.

materials.direction: 儿童使用电子设备应该被限制吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 长时间屏幕暴露 → 视力下降/睡眠紊乱/运动不足 → 儿童身体发育受损
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Prolonged screen exposure → deteriorating eyesight, disrupted sleep, and lack of exercise → children's physical development is harmed
materials.example: WHO建议5岁以下儿童每日屏幕时间不超过1小时；中国青少年近视率已超60%
materials.example_en: The WHO recommends no more than 1 hour of daily screen time for children under 5; China's youth myopia rate already exceeds 60%
materials.topic_sentence: 过度使用电子设备损害儿童的身体健康。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Excessive use of electronic devices harms children's physical health.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"屏幕伤了什么"（伤身体=近视肥胖、伤大脑=注意力）；反方想"屏幕给了什么"（给学习工具=教育App、给未来技能=数字素养）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Prolonged screen exposure leads to deteriorating eyesight, disrupted sleep, and lack of exercise, all of which harm children's physical development.

materials.direction: 儿童使用电子设备应该被限制吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 碎片化信息浏览 → 注意力持续时间缩短 → 深度阅读和思考能力退化
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Browsing fragmented information → attention span shortens → ability for deep reading and thinking deteriorates
materials.example: 许多小学老师反映，习惯刷短视频的学生在课堂上无法专注超过10分钟，阅读整本书的能力明显退化
materials.example_en: Many primary school teachers report that students accustomed to short videos cannot focus for more than 10 minutes in class, and their ability to read entire books has noticeably declined

materials.direction: 环保是政府的责任还是个人的责任？
materials.reasoning_chain: 环境问题涉及整个工业体系 → 个人无权关停污染工厂或制定排放标准 → 没有政府强制介入，污染企业不会主动改变
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Environmental problems involve the entire industrial system → individuals have no power to shut down polluting factories or set emission standards → without government enforcement, polluting companies will not change voluntarily
materials.example: 欧盟碳排放交易体系使工业排放量10年下降35%，远超个人行为改变的效果
materials.example_en: The EU Emissions Trading System reduced industrial emissions by 35% over 10 years, far exceeding the impact of individual behaviour changes
materials.topic_sentence: 环境保护主要是政府的责任。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Environmental protection is primarily the government's responsibility.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（政府）想"个人太弱"（规模大=需要政府强制、个人影响=微不足道）；反方（个人）想"消费者有力量"（用钱投票=市场驱动、星星之火=集体运动）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Environmental problems involve the entire industrial system, and since individuals have no power to shut down polluting factories or set emission standards, only government enforcement can compel polluting companies to change.

materials.direction: 环保是政府的责任还是个人的责任？
materials.reasoning_chain: 个人减排量微不足道（如少开一次车节省的碳排放不到1kg）→ 而一家工厂一天排放数百吨 → 个人行为对全球变暖几乎没有实质影响
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Individual emission reductions are negligible (e.g. skipping one car trip saves less than 1 kg of CO₂) → while a single factory emits hundreds of tonnes per day → individual actions have virtually no real impact on global warming
materials.example: 即使全英国所有家庭都完美执行垃圾分类，减少的碳排放也不到全国工业排放总量的1%
materials.example_en: Even if every household in the UK sorted waste perfectly, the reduction in carbon emissions would be less than 1% of total national industrial emissions
materials.topic_sentence: 个人行为对解决环境问题的作用微乎其微。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Individual actions have a negligible impact on solving environmental problems.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（政府）想"个人太弱"（规模大=需要政府强制、个人影响=微不足道）；反方（个人）想"消费者有力量"（用钱投票=市场驱动、星星之火=集体运动）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Individual emission reductions are negligible compared to the hundreds of tonnes a single factory emits daily, meaning personal actions have virtually no real impact on global warming.

materials.direction: 环保是政府的责任还是个人的责任？
materials.reasoning_chain: 消费者选择决定市场方向 → 如果人人拒绝高污染产品，这些产品销量就会暴跌 → 企业利润受损，被迫转向清洁生产
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Consumer choices determine market direction → if everyone rejects high-pollution products, sales will plummet → companies lose profits and are forced to shift to clean production
materials.example: 越来越多消费者选择环保品牌（如Patagonia），迫使快时尚品牌推出可持续产品线以挽回市场份额
materials.example_en: Growing numbers of consumers choosing eco-brands like Patagonia have forced fast-fashion brands to launch sustainable product lines to regain market share
materials.topic_sentence: 个人消费选择能有效推动企业环保转型。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Individual consumer choices can effectively drive corporate environmental reform.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（政府）想"个人太弱"（规模大=需要政府强制、个人影响=微不足道）；反方（个人）想"消费者有力量"（用钱投票=市场驱动、星星之火=集体运动）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Consumer choices determine market direction: if everyone rejects high-pollution products, sales will plummet, forcing companies to shift to clean production in order to survive.

materials.direction: 环保是政府的责任还是个人的责任？
materials.reasoning_chain: 个人环保行为有示范效应 → 影响周围人效仿 → 逐渐形成大规模社会共识和运动 → 反过来推动政府制定环保政策
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Individual environmental actions have a demonstration effect → influence others to follow → gradually form large-scale social consensus and movements → which in turn push governments to adopt environmental policies
materials.example: 瑞典「飞行羞耻」运动从个人倡议扩散为全国运动，推动铁路投资增加
materials.example_en: Sweden's 'flight shame' movement spread from individual advocacy to a national campaign, driving increased investment in railways
materials.topic_sentence: 个人环保行动能汇聚成推动社会变革的强大力量。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Individual environmental actions can build into a powerful force for social change.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（政府）想"个人太弱"（规模大=需要政府强制、个人影响=微不足道）；反方（个人）想"消费者有力量"（用钱投票=市场驱动、星星之火=集体运动）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Individual environmental actions have a demonstration effect that influences others to follow, gradually forming large-scale social movements that in turn push governments to adopt environmental policies.

materials.direction: 经济发展和环境保护能否兼顾？
materials.reasoning_chain: 清洁能源产业本身创造大量就业和GDP → 国家在环保的同时经济也在增长 → 证明经济发展和环保并非对立关系
materials.reasoning_chain_en: The clean energy industry itself creates massive employment and GDP → the economy grows while the environment is protected → proving that economic development and environmental protection are not in conflict
materials.example: 中国新能源产业（光伏/电动车）成为经济增长新引擎，出口全球领先
materials.example_en: China's new energy industries (solar panels, electric vehicles) have become a new engine of economic growth, with exports leading the world
materials.topic_sentence: 经济发展和环境保护完全可以兼顾。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Economic development and environmental protection can go hand in hand.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"双赢"（绿色产业=赚钱、破坏环境=更贵）；反方想"现实很骨感"（穷国先吃饭=阶段、技术太贵=成本）
materials.chain_sentence_en: The clean energy industry itself creates massive employment and GDP, proving that the economy can grow while the environment is protected and that the two are not in conflict.

materials.direction: 经济发展和环境保护能否兼顾？
materials.reasoning_chain: 环境破坏引发洪灾/干旱/疾病 → 灾后重建和医疗支出远超前期环保投入 → 不环保反而花更多钱、经济损失更大
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Environmental destruction causes floods, droughts, and disease → post-disaster reconstruction and healthcare costs far exceed earlier environmental investment → neglecting the environment ends up costing more
materials.example: 世界银行估算气候变化到2030年将使全球GDP损失5%以上
materials.example_en: The World Bank estimates that climate change will cause global GDP losses of over 5% by 2030
materials.topic_sentence: 保护环境从长远来看就是保护经济利益。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Protecting the environment is, in the long run, protecting economic interests.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"双赢"（绿色产业=赚钱、破坏环境=更贵）；反方想"现实很骨感"（穷国先吃饭=阶段、技术太贵=成本）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Environmental destruction causes floods, droughts, and disease, and the costs of post-disaster reconstruction and healthcare far exceed what earlier environmental investment would have required.

materials.direction: 经济发展和环境保护能否兼顾？
materials.reasoning_chain: 贫困国家首要任务是解决温饱 → 强制高环保标准大幅增加生产成本 → 工厂无法盈利、工业化停滞、人民持续贫困
materials.reasoning_chain_en: The top priority of poor countries is to feed their people → enforcing high environmental standards greatly raises production costs → factories cannot profit, industrialisation stalls, and people remain in poverty

materials.example_en: Hundreds of millions in African countries still lack electricity; restricting fossil fuels effectively restricts their path out of poverty
materials.topic_sentence: 对贫困国家而言，环保标准可能阻碍经济发展。
materials.topic_sentence_en: For developing countries, strict environmental standards may hinder economic growth.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"双赢"（绿色产业=赚钱、破坏环境=更贵）；反方想"现实很骨感"（穷国先吃饭=阶段、技术太贵=成本）
materials.chain_sentence_en: For countries whose top priority is feeding their people, enforcing high environmental standards greatly raises production costs, preventing factories from turning a profit and trapping the population in poverty.

materials.direction: 经济发展和环境保护能否兼顾？
materials.reasoning_chain: 清洁技术成本高 → 中小企业无力承担 → 过快转型导致企业倒闭、失业潮

materials.topic_sentence: 过快的绿色转型可能对企业造成毁灭性打击。
materials.topic_sentence_en: An overly rapid green transition may devastate businesses.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"双赢"（绿色产业=赚钱、破坏环境=更贵）；反方想"现实很骨感"（穷国先吃饭=阶段、技术太贵=成本）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Clean technology is expensive, and since small and medium enterprises cannot afford it, an overly rapid green transition may lead to widespread business closures and waves of unemployment.

materials.direction: 应该限制私家车使用吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 汽车尾气是城市空气污染主要来源 → 限制私家车可直接减少尾气排放 → 空气质量显著改善

materials.topic_sentence: 限制私家车有助于改善城市空气质量。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Restricting private cars helps improve urban air quality.

materials.direction: 应该限制私家车使用吗？

materials.topic_sentence_en: Reducing private cars can significantly improve urban transport efficiency.

materials.chain_sentence_en: When there are too many private cars, severe traffic congestion wastes commuters' time and fuel, reducing the overall efficiency of urban transport.

materials.direction: 应该限制私家车使用吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 老人/孩子/残障人士无法使用公共交通 → 私家车是他们唯一的出行方式 → 限车直接导致这些群体出行困难甚至无法就医

materials.example_en: The elderly, pregnant women, and disabled people cannot crowd onto buses or cycle; after car restrictions, these groups struggle even to reach hospitals
materials.topic_sentence: 限制私家车对弱势群体的基本出行需求造成严重影响。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Restricting private cars severely impacts the basic mobility needs of vulnerable groups.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"城市好处"（少尾气=环境、少堵车=效率）；反方想"人的难处"（弱势群体=出行需求、公交不行=替代不成熟）
materials.chain_sentence_en: The elderly, children, and disabled people often cannot use public transport, making private cars their only means of travel; restricting cars directly causes these groups difficulty getting around or even accessing medical care.

materials.direction: 应该限制私家车使用吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 许多城市公共交通覆盖不足 → 贸然限车后居民无替代出行方式 → 通勤时间暴增、生活质量严重下降

materials.example_en: After some cities imposed driving restrictions, residents faced difficulties hailing taxis and overcrowded buses, which actually lowered quality of life
materials.topic_sentence: 在公共交通不完善时限制私家车是不现实的。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Restricting private cars is impractical when public transport remains inadequate.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"城市好处"（少尾气=环境、少堵车=效率）；反方想"人的难处"（弱势群体=出行需求、公交不行=替代不成熟）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Many cities have inadequate public transport coverage, so hasty car restrictions leave residents with no alternative, causing commute times to soar and quality of life to drop sharply.

materials.direction: 垃圾食品应该征税吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 加税 → 价格上升 → 消费量下降 → 肥胖率/糖尿病发病率降低
materials.reasoning_chain_en: A tax is imposed on junk food → prices rise → consumption falls → obesity and diabetes rates decline
materials.example: 墨西哥2014年征收含糖饮料税后，含糖饮料销量下降12%
materials.example_en: After Mexico introduced a sugary drink tax in 2014, sales of sugary beverages dropped by 12%
materials.topic_sentence: 对垃圾食品征税有助于改善公共健康。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Taxing junk food can help improve public health.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"税的好处"（少吃=健康、少病=省医疗费）；反方想"税的坏处"（管太多=自由、穷人更惨=不公平）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When a tax is imposed on junk food, prices rise and consumption falls, which leads to a decline in obesity and diabetes rates.

materials.direction: 垃圾食品应该征税吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 不健康饮食导致慢性病大量增加 → 公共医疗系统不堪重负 → 征税促使企业主动降低有害成分含量，从源头减少健康危害
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Unhealthy diets cause a surge in chronic diseases → the public healthcare system is overwhelmed → taxation incentivises companies to voluntarily reduce harmful ingredients, cutting health risks at the source
materials.example: 英国糖税实施后，饮料公司主动降低产品含糖量以避税
materials.example_en: After the UK sugar tax was implemented, beverage companies voluntarily reduced the sugar content of their products to avoid the tax
materials.topic_sentence: 垃圾食品税能有效减轻公共医疗系统的负担。
materials.topic_sentence_en: A junk food tax can effectively ease the burden on public healthcare systems.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"税的好处"（少吃=健康、少病=省医疗费）；反方想"税的坏处"（管太多=自由、穷人更惨=不公平）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Unhealthy diets cause a surge in chronic diseases that overwhelm the public healthcare system; taxation incentivises companies to reduce harmful ingredients, cutting health risks at the source.

materials.direction: 垃圾食品应该征税吗？

materials.example_en: Denmark once imposed a fat tax, but strong public opposition and unclear results forced its cancellation after just one year
materials.topic_sentence: 政府不应通过征税干预公民的饮食自由。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Governments should not use taxation to interfere with citizens' dietary freedom.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"税的好处"（少吃=健康、少病=省医疗费）；反方想"税的坏处"（管太多=自由、穷人更惨=不公平）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Diet is a personal choice, and government interference through taxation provokes public resentment, which makes the policy difficult to enforce or may even force its cancellation.

materials.direction: 垃圾食品应该征税吗？

materials.example_en: After Mexico introduced its sugary drink tax, residents in low-income communities switched to cheaper, lower-quality beverages, and health outcomes did not improve
materials.topic_sentence: 垃圾食品税对低收入群体不公平。
materials.topic_sentence_en: A junk food tax is unfair to low-income groups.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"税的好处"（少吃=健康、少病=省医疗费）；反方想"税的坏处"（管太多=自由、穷人更惨=不公平）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Since the poor spend a higher share of their income on food, a food tax hits low-income groups disproportionately harder, thereby worsening social inequality.

materials.direction: 政府是否应该强制推广运动？

materials.example_en: Japanese companies implement workplace exercise breaks, resulting in improved employee health indicators and work efficiency
materials.topic_sentence: 政府推广运动有助于预防疾病、提升国民健康。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Government-promoted exercise helps prevent disease and improve public health.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"运动的好处"（少生病=预防疾病、少犯罪=社会效益）；反方想"强制的坏处"（逼人反感=适得其反、钱花错地方=资源浪费）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Regular exercise prevents cardiovascular disease, obesity, and depression, improving overall national health and consequently reducing healthcare spending.

materials.direction: 政府是否应该强制推广运动？
materials.reasoning_chain: 体育活动给青少年提供消耗精力的正面出口 → 同时建立归属感和社交圈，减少无所事事的闲散时间 → 打架斗殴和反社会行为减少，社区治安改善
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Sports provide teenagers with a positive outlet for energy → while building a sense of belonging and social circles, reducing idle time → fights and antisocial behaviour decrease, and community safety improves
materials.example: 英国社区体育项目使参与区域的青少年犯罪率下降了40%
materials.example_en: A UK community sports programme reduced juvenile crime rates by 40% in participating areas
materials.topic_sentence: 推广体育活动有助于降低青少年犯罪率。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Promoting sports helps reduce juvenile crime rates.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"运动的好处"（少生病=预防疾病、少犯罪=社会效益）；反方想"强制的坏处"（逼人反感=适得其反、钱花错地方=资源浪费）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Sports provide teenagers with a positive outlet for energy while building a sense of belonging, which reduces idle time and leads to fewer fights and less antisocial behaviour.

materials.direction: 政府是否应该强制推广运动？
materials.reasoning_chain: 强制规定运动时间和方式 → 人们对运动产生抵触心理 → 反而更不愿主动运动，参与率下降
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Mandating exercise times and forms → people develop resistance toward exercise → they become even less willing to exercise voluntarily, and participation rates drop
materials.example: 日本部分学校取消强制晨跑后，学生反而自发组建跑步社团，自愿参与率比强制时期更高
materials.example_en: After some Japanese schools cancelled mandatory morning runs, students spontaneously formed running clubs, with voluntary participation rates higher than during the compulsory period
materials.topic_sentence: 强制推广运动可能适得其反，反而降低参与率。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Mandatory exercise programmes may backfire and actually reduce participation rates.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"运动的好处"（少生病=预防疾病、少犯罪=社会效益）；反方想"强制的坏处"（逼人反感=适得其反、钱花错地方=资源浪费）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Mandating specific exercise times and forms causes people to develop resistance toward physical activity, making them even less willing to exercise voluntarily and actually lowering participation rates.

materials.direction: 政府是否应该强制推广运动？
materials.reasoning_chain: 政府资金有限 → 大量投入体育设施会挤占教育/医疗预算 → 其他更紧迫的公共服务质量下降
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Government funds are limited → heavy investment in sports facilities crowds out education/healthcare budgets → quality of other more urgent public services declines
materials.example: 巴西为世界杯建造大量体育场馆，同期多所公立医院因预算被削减而关闭
materials.example_en: Brazil built numerous stadiums for the World Cup while multiple public hospitals closed due to budget cuts during the same period
materials.topic_sentence: 政府资源应优先投入比体育更紧迫的领域。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Government resources should be directed to more urgent areas than sports.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"运动的好处"（少生病=预防疾病、少犯罪=社会效益）；反方想"强制的坏处"（逼人反感=适得其反、钱花错地方=资源浪费）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Government funds are limited, and heavy investment in sports facilities crowds out education and healthcare budgets, causing more urgent public services to decline in quality.

materials.direction: 工作与生活的平衡重要吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 长期过劳 → 身心疾病（猝死/抑郁/家庭破裂）→ 最终个人生活质量崩塌
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Chronic overwork → leads to physical and mental health problems, including depression and family breakdown → ultimately, one's overall quality of life deteriorates severely
materials.example: 日本「过劳死」(karoshi)现象引发全球关注，每年数百人因工作猝死
materials.example_en: Japan's 'karoshi' (death from overwork) phenomenon has drawn global attention, with hundreds dying from work-related causes each year
materials.topic_sentence: 工作与生活的平衡对身心健康至关重要。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Work-life balance is essential for physical and mental well-being.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"平衡的好处"（不猝死=健康、休息好反而干得好=效率）；反方想"不平衡的理由"（年轻该拼=阶段、没钱谈什么平衡=现实）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Chronic overwork leads to serious physical and mental health problems, including depression and family breakdown, ultimately causing one's overall quality of life to deteriorate severely.

materials.direction: 工作与生活的平衡重要吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 适当休息 → 恢复精力和创造力 → 反而提高工作产出和质量
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Adequate rest → restores energy and creativity → actually increases work output and quality
materials.example: 微软日本试行四天工作制后，生产力提升了40%
materials.example_en: After Microsoft Japan trialled a four-day work week, productivity rose by 40%
materials.topic_sentence: 良好的工作生活平衡反而能提高工作效率。
materials.topic_sentence_en: A good work-life balance actually improves work productivity.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"平衡的好处"（不猝死=健康、休息好反而干得好=效率）；反方想"不平衡的理由"（年轻该拼=阶段、没钱谈什么平衡=现实）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Adequate rest restores energy and creativity, which actually increases work output and quality rather than reducing it.

materials.direction: 工作与生活的平衡重要吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 年轻时拼搏积累技能和人脉 → 30-40岁时拥有更高收入和职位 → 中年后反而有更多自由支配时间和经济保障
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Working hard when young builds skills and networks → by 30-40 one enjoys higher income and positions → in middle age one actually has more free time and financial security
materials.example: 硅谷工程师普遍在25-35岁高强度工作积累股权，35岁后许多人选择半退休或转为顾问，实现了财务自由
materials.example_en: Silicon Valley engineers commonly work intensively from 25 to 35 to accumulate stock options, and many choose semi-retirement or consulting roles after 35, achieving financial freedom
materials.topic_sentence: 在职业关键期适当牺牲平衡有利于长远发展。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Sacrificing some balance during critical career stages benefits long-term development.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"平衡的好处"（不猝死=健康、休息好反而干得好=效率）；反方想"不平衡的理由"（年轻该拼=阶段、没钱谈什么平衡=现实）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Working hard when young builds essential skills and networks, so that by one's thirties or forties, one enjoys higher income and more free time — a long-term payoff worth the early sacrifice.

materials.direction: 工作与生活的平衡重要吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 生活成本高（房贷/子女教育）→ 不加班收入无法覆盖基本开支 → 低收入者被迫加班，根本没有选择「平衡」的余地
materials.reasoning_chain_en: High living costs (mortgage, children's education) → without overtime, income cannot cover basic expenses → low-income earners are forced to work overtime and have no room to choose 'balance'
materials.example: 发展中国家的工薪阶层如果追求「平衡」，可能连基本生活都无法维持
materials.example_en: Working-class people in developing countries may not be able to maintain even basic living standards if they pursue 'balance'
materials.topic_sentence: 对许多人而言，工作生活平衡是一种经济奢侈。
materials.topic_sentence_en: For many people, work-life balance is an economic luxury they cannot afford.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"平衡的好处"（不猝死=健康、休息好反而干得好=效率）；反方想"不平衡的理由"（年轻该拼=阶段、没钱谈什么平衡=现实）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When living costs such as mortgages and children's education are high, income without overtime cannot cover basic expenses, leaving low-income earners with no room to choose work-life balance.

materials.direction: 政府应优先投资教育还是医疗/基建？
materials.reasoning_chain: 教育提升人口素质 → 高素质劳动力创造更多经济价值 → 回报是几十年的复利效应
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Education raises population quality → a high-quality workforce creates more economic value → returns compound over decades
materials.example: 韩国60年代起重金投入教育，一代人内从贫困国跃升为发达经济体
materials.example_en: South Korea invested heavily in education from the 1960s and rose from a poor nation to a developed economy within one generation
materials.topic_sentence: 教育是回报最高的长期公共投资。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Education is the highest-return long-term public investment.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（教育优先）想"教育回报"（人才=长远回报、脱贫=根治贫困）；反方（医疗/基建优先）想"基础先行"（没命怎么学=健康优先、没路怎么到=基建支撑）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Education raises the quality of the population, and a high-quality workforce creates more economic value, producing returns that compound over decades.

materials.direction: 政府应优先投资教育还是医疗/基建？
materials.reasoning_chain: 教育是脱贫最有效手段 → 受教育者收入更高 → 减少对福利系统的长期依赖
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Education is the most effective means to escape poverty → educated people earn more → reducing long-term dependence on the welfare system
materials.example: 世界银行数据：每多受一年教育，个人终身收入平均增加10%
materials.example_en: World Bank data: each additional year of education raises an individual's lifetime income by an average of 10%
materials.topic_sentence: 教育是打破贫困循环最有效的途径。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Education is the most effective way to break the cycle of poverty.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（教育优先）想"教育回报"（人才=长远回报、脱贫=根治贫困）；反方（医疗/基建优先）想"基础先行"（没命怎么学=健康优先、没路怎么到=基建支撑）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Education is the most effective means to escape poverty because educated people earn significantly more, reducing their long-term dependence on the welfare system.

materials.direction: 政府应优先投资教育还是医疗/基建？
materials.reasoning_chain: 没有健康就无法学习和工作 → 如果国民连基本医疗都没有，教育投资的效果会被疾病抵消 → 培养出的人才因健康问题无法产出，教育投入被浪费
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Without health one cannot study or work → if citizens lack basic healthcare, the benefits of educational investment are cancelled out by disease → trained talent cannot be productive due to health problems, wasting the education investment
materials.example: 非洲疟疾高发地区的儿童因反复患病缺课率极高，教育投资效果大打折扣
materials.example_en: In malaria-prone regions of Africa, children miss school repeatedly due to illness, greatly diminishing the impact of educational investment
materials.topic_sentence: 医疗保障比教育投资更为紧迫。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Healthcare provision is more urgent than investment in education.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（教育优先）想"教育回报"（人才=长远回报、脱贫=根治贫困）；反方（医疗/基建优先）想"基础先行"（没命怎么学=健康优先、没路怎么到=基建支撑）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Without basic healthcare, citizens cannot study or work effectively; if people lack health, the benefits of educational investment are cancelled out by disease, wasting the resources spent on education.

materials.direction: 政府应优先投资教育还是医疗/基建？
materials.angle: 教育需要基础设施支撑
materials.reasoning_chain: 道路不通/电力不足 → 学校建了学生也无法到达或正常上课 → 教育投资因基础设施缺失而无法产生效果
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Roads are impassable and electricity is insufficient → even if schools are built, students cannot reach them or attend classes normally → educational investment fails to produce results due to lack of infrastructure
materials.example: 印度农村通电通网后，在线教育参与率大幅上升
materials.example_en: After rural India gained electricity and internet access, online education participation rates rose dramatically
materials.topic_sentence: 基础设施建设是教育投资发挥效果的前提。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Infrastructure development is a prerequisite for educational investment to be effective.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（教育优先）想"教育回报"（人才=长远回报、脱贫=根治贫困）；反方（医疗/基建优先）想"基础先行"（没命怎么学=健康优先、没路怎么到=基建支撑）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When roads are impassable and electricity is insufficient, students cannot reach schools or attend classes normally, meaning educational investment fails to produce results without adequate infrastructure.

materials.direction: 犯罪治理应侧重预防还是惩罚？
materials.reasoning_chain: 一个囚犯每年花费纳税人数万美元 → 同样的钱用于教育/就业培训可帮助数十人不走上犯罪道路 → 预防性投入的社会回报远高于监禁
materials.reasoning_chain_en: One prisoner costs taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars per year → the same money spent on education/job training can keep dozens from turning to crime → the social return on preventive investment far exceeds that of imprisonment
materials.example: 美国每年监狱支出超800亿美元，但再犯率高达76%
materials.example_en: The U.S. spends over $80 billion annually on prisons, yet the recidivism rate is as high as 76%
materials.topic_sentence: 犯罪预防比事后惩罚更具成本效益。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Crime prevention is more cost-effective than punishment after the fact.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（预防）想"省钱治本"（监狱太贵=成本、根源在贫困=治本）；反方（惩罚）想"吓人公平"（严刑=威慑、受害者需要=正义）
materials.chain_sentence_en: One prisoner costs taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars per year, whereas the same money spent on education and job training could prevent dozens of people from turning to crime in the first place.

materials.direction: 犯罪治理应侧重预防还是惩罚？
materials.reasoning_chain: 犯罪根源是贫困/教育缺失/心理问题 → 只惩罚不解决根源 → 出狱后再犯率高
materials.reasoning_chain_en: The root causes of crime are poverty, lack of education, and psychological problems → punishment alone does not address the root causes → reoffending rates after release remain high
materials.example: 挪威以教育康复为核心的监狱模式，再犯率仅20%，全球最低
materials.example_en: Norway's prison model centred on education and rehabilitation has a reoffending rate of just 20%, the lowest in the world
materials.topic_sentence: 只有解决犯罪根源才能真正降低犯罪率。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Only by addressing the root causes of crime can society truly reduce crime rates.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（预防）想"省钱治本"（监狱太贵=成本、根源在贫困=治本）；反方（惩罚）想"吓人公平"（严刑=威慑、受害者需要=正义）
materials.chain_sentence_en: The root causes of crime are poverty, lack of education, and psychological problems; punishment alone does not address these causes, which is why reoffending rates after release remain stubbornly high.

materials.direction: 犯罪治理应侧重预防还是惩罚？
materials.reasoning_chain: 严厉惩罚的案例被媒体报道 → 潜在犯罪者看到后果而放弃犯罪念头 → 整体犯罪率因此下降
materials.reasoning_chain_en: The media reports cases of severe punishment → potential criminals see the consequences and abandon their criminal intentions → overall crime rates decline as a result
materials.example: 新加坡严刑峻法（鞭刑/死刑），犯罪率极低，社会治安全球领先
materials.example_en: Singapore's harsh penalties (caning, death penalty) are associated with extremely low crime rates and world-leading public safety
materials.topic_sentence: 严厉的惩罚能有效威慑潜在犯罪者。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Severe punishment effectively deters potential criminals.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（预防）想"省钱治本"（监狱太贵=成本、根源在贫困=治本）；反方（惩罚）想"吓人公平"（严刑=威慑、受害者需要=正义）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When the media reports cases of severe punishment, potential criminals see the consequences and abandon their criminal intentions, which contributes to a decline in overall crime rates.

materials.direction: 犯罪治理应侧重预防还是惩罚？
materials.reasoning_chain: 受害者遭受了实际伤害，需要看到加害者承担后果 → 惩罚给受害者提供心理上的正义感和安慰 → 如果犯罪不受惩罚，公众会认为法律无用，法律权威就会瓦解
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Victims suffer real harm and need to see offenders face consequences → punishment provides victims with a sense of justice and comfort → if crime goes unpunished, the public loses faith in the law and legal authority collapses
materials.example: 民调显示大多数犯罪受害者认为适当惩罚对其心理康复至关重要
materials.example_en: Polls show that most crime victims consider appropriate punishment essential to their psychological recovery
materials.topic_sentence: 惩罚是维护法律权威和社会正义的基础。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Punishment is fundamental to upholding legal authority and social justice.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（预防）想"省钱治本"（监狱太贵=成本、根源在贫困=治本）；反方（惩罚）想"吓人公平"（严刑=威慑、受害者需要=正义）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Victims suffer real harm and need to see offenders face consequences; punishment provides them with a sense of justice, and without it, the public would lose faith in the law and legal authority would collapse.

materials.direction: 贫富差距是否需要政府干预？
materials.reasoning_chain: 贫富差距过大 → 底层民众感到绝望和愤怒 → 这种情绪转化为犯罪、抗议甚至民粹政治 → 社会动荡风险上升
materials.reasoning_chain_en: An excessive wealth gap → breeds desperation and resentment among the lower class → which manifests as rising crime, protests, or populist politics → increasing the risk of social unrest
materials.example: 拉丁美洲贫富悬殊的国家普遍社会犯罪率高、政治不稳定
materials.example_en: Latin American countries with extreme wealth gaps generally suffer from high crime rates and political instability
materials.topic_sentence: 贫富差距过大会威胁社会稳定。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Excessive wealth inequality threatens social stability.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"不管会怎样"（穷人暴动=不稳定、富人垄断机会=不公平）；反方想"管了会怎样"（富人跑了=损害激励、官僚截留=低效）
materials.chain_sentence_en: An excessive wealth gap breeds desperation and resentment among the lower class, which manifests as rising crime, protests, or populist politics, increasing the risk of social unrest.

materials.direction: 贫富差距是否需要政府干预？
materials.reasoning_chain: 富人子女享有更好的教育和人脉资源 → 阶层固化，穷人后代无论多努力都难以突破 → 社会丧失活力，底层人才被浪费，整体创新力下降
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Children of the wealthy enjoy better education and networks → class becomes rigid, and the poor cannot break through no matter how hard they try → society loses vitality, talent at the bottom is wasted, and overall innovation declines
materials.example: 美国顶尖大学学生中来自最富有20%家庭的比例超过70%
materials.example_en: Over 70% of students at top U.S. universities come from the wealthiest 20% of families
materials.topic_sentence: 政府干预贫富差距对于保障机会公平不可或缺。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Government intervention in wealth inequality is essential for ensuring equal opportunity.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"不管会怎样"（穷人暴动=不稳定、富人垄断机会=不公平）；反方想"管了会怎样"（富人跑了=损害激励、官僚截留=低效）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When the children of the wealthy enjoy superior education and networks, class becomes rigid and the poor cannot break through regardless of effort, causing society to lose vitality and squander talent at the bottom.

materials.direction: 贫富差距是否需要政府干预？
materials.reasoning_chain: 高税收重分配 → 成功者积极性受挫 → 创新和创业动力下降 → 经济总量萎缩
materials.reasoning_chain_en: High taxes and heavy redistribution → successful people lose motivation → innovation and entrepreneurial drive decline → the overall economy shrinks
materials.example: 法国曾征收75%超级富人税，导致大量富人和企业外迁，税收反而减少
materials.example_en: France once imposed a 75% super-rich tax, causing many wealthy individuals and businesses to leave, which actually reduced tax revenue
materials.topic_sentence: 过度的财富再分配会抑制创新和创业动力。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Excessive wealth redistribution stifles innovation and entrepreneurial motivation.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"不管会怎样"（穷人暴动=不稳定、富人垄断机会=不公平）；反方想"管了会怎样"（富人跑了=损害激励、官僚截留=低效）
materials.chain_sentence_en: High taxes and heavy redistribution discourage successful people from taking risks, which reduces innovation and entrepreneurial drive and may ultimately shrink the overall economy.

materials.direction: 贫富差距是否需要政府干预？
materials.reasoning_chain: 政府再分配需要庞大官僚机构来执行 → 执行过程中容易产生效率损耗和腐败 → 税收被层层截留，最终穷人拿到的远少于被征收的总额
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Government redistribution requires a massive bureaucracy to execute → the process is prone to inefficiency and corruption → taxes are siphoned off at every level, and the poor ultimately receive far less than the total collected
materials.example: 世界银行报告显示，许多发展中国家的福利金从拨付到受益人手中，途中损耗高达30%-50%
materials.example_en: World Bank reports show that in many developing countries, 30-50% of welfare funds are lost between disbursement and reaching the final beneficiary
materials.topic_sentence: 政府的再分配政策往往因官僚低效而效果大打折扣。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Government redistribution policies are often undermined by bureaucratic inefficiency.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"不管会怎样"（穷人暴动=不稳定、富人垄断机会=不公平）；反方想"管了会怎样"（富人跑了=损害激励、官僚截留=低效）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Government redistribution requires a massive bureaucracy that is prone to inefficiency and corruption, meaning taxes are siphoned off at every level and the poor ultimately receive far less than the total collected.

materials.direction: 城乡差距如何看待？
materials.reasoning_chain: 城市提供更多就业和教育机会 → 年轻人能获得更高收入和更快的职业成长 → 个人和家庭的生活水平显著提升
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Cities offer more employment and education opportunities → young people earn higher incomes and experience faster career growth → individuals and families enjoy significantly improved living standards
materials.example: 中国一线城市平均工资是农村的3-5倍，吸引大量人才流入
materials.example_en: Average wages in China's first-tier cities are 3-5 times those in rural areas, attracting a massive influx of talent
materials.topic_sentence: 城市化为个人提供了更好的发展机会。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Urbanisation provides individuals with better opportunities for development.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（城市化好）想"城市的好"（工资高=个人发展、人才聚集=经济效率）；反方想"城市化的代价"（房价交通=城市病、村里没人了=乡村凋敝）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Cities offer more employment and education opportunities, enabling young people to earn higher incomes and experience faster career growth, which significantly improves their living standards.

materials.direction: 城乡差距如何看待？
materials.reasoning_chain: 人口集中 → 产业聚集效应 → 创新协作更高效 → 推动整体经济增长
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Population concentrates in cities → agglomeration effects emerge → innovation and collaboration become more efficient → driving overall economic growth
materials.example: 硅谷/深圳等城市因人才密度高形成创新生态，产出全球领先
materials.example_en: Cities like Silicon Valley and Shenzhen have formed innovation ecosystems due to high talent density, with globally leading output
materials.topic_sentence: 人口集中有利于提升经济效率和创新能力。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Population concentration boosts economic efficiency and innovation.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（城市化好）想"城市的好"（工资高=个人发展、人才聚集=经济效率）；反方想"城市化的代价"（房价交通=城市病、村里没人了=乡村凋敝）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When population concentrates in cities, agglomeration effects emerge and innovation becomes more efficient, driving overall economic growth.

materials.direction: 城乡差距如何看待？
materials.reasoning_chain: 人口过度涌入 → 房价暴涨/交通拥堵/环境恶化 → 城市生活质量下降
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Excessive population influx → soaring house prices, traffic congestion, and environmental degradation → urban quality of life declines
materials.example: 东京/北京等超级城市房价让年轻人绝望，「逃离北上广」成为社会议题
materials.example_en: Housing prices in megacities like Tokyo and Beijing leave young people in despair; 'fleeing first-tier cities' has become a social phenomenon
materials.topic_sentence: 过度城市化会严重降低居民的生活质量。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Excessive urbanisation significantly reduces residents' quality of life.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（城市化好）想"城市的好"（工资高=个人发展、人才聚集=经济效率）；反方想"城市化的代价"（房价交通=城市病、村里没人了=乡村凋敝）
materials.chain_sentence_en: An excessive population influx causes house prices to soar, traffic to congest, and the environment to degrade, ultimately reducing the quality of life for urban residents.

materials.direction: 城乡差距如何看待？
materials.reasoning_chain: 年轻人流失 → 农村只剩老人孩子 → 农业衰退/公共服务萎缩 → 城乡差距恶性循环
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Young people leave → only the elderly and children remain in rural areas → agriculture declines and public services shrink → the urban-rural gap worsens in a vicious cycle
materials.example: 日本农村大量「消亡村落」，空置房屋超800万套
materials.example_en: Japan has numerous 'dying villages' in rural areas, with over 8 million vacant houses
materials.topic_sentence: 城市化正在加速农村社区的衰落。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Urbanisation is accelerating the decline of rural communities.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（城市化好）想"城市的好"（工资高=个人发展、人才聚集=经济效率）；反方想"城市化的代价"（房价交通=城市病、村里没人了=乡村凋敝）
materials.chain_sentence_en: As young people leave for cities, only the elderly and children remain in rural areas, leading to agricultural decline and shrinking public services in a vicious cycle that widens the urban-rural gap.

materials.direction: 全球化导致文化同质化，是好是坏？
materials.reasoning_chain: 接触多元文化 → 个人视野和审美更加开阔 → 在饮食/艺术/生活方式上有了更多选择，生活满意度提升
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Exposure to diverse cultures → broader personal horizons and aesthetics → more choices in food, art, and lifestyle, raising life satisfaction
materials.example: 全球各城市都能吃到各国美食、看到各国电影，生活多样性前所未有
materials.example_en: Cities worldwide now offer cuisines and films from every country, creating unprecedented diversity in daily life
materials.topic_sentence: 文化全球化丰富了人们的生活选择。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Cultural globalisation enriches people's lifestyle choices.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（好）想"个人得到了什么"（选择多=丰富生活、理解多=和平）；反方（坏）想"弱者失去了什么"（本土文化=消亡、本土产业=被挤压）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Exposure to diverse cultures broadens personal horizons and aesthetics, giving people more choices in food, art, and lifestyle, which raises overall life satisfaction.

materials.direction: 全球化导致文化同质化，是好是坏？
materials.reasoning_chain: 文化交流 → 减少偏见和误解 → 不同国家人民更容易相互尊重和合作
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Cultural exchange → reduces prejudice and misunderstanding → people of different countries find it easier to respect and cooperate with each other
materials.example: 欧盟国家间文化交流项目(Erasmus)使参与者对他国好感度显著上升
materials.example_en: The EU's Erasmus cultural exchange programme significantly increased participants' positive attitudes toward other countries
materials.topic_sentence: 文化交流有助于促进国际理解与和平。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Cultural exchange promotes international understanding and peace.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（好）想"个人得到了什么"（选择多=丰富生活、理解多=和平）；反方（坏）想"弱者失去了什么"（本土文化=消亡、本土产业=被挤压）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Cultural exchange reduces prejudice and misunderstanding between nations, making it easier for people of different countries to respect and cooperate with each other.

materials.direction: 全球化导致文化同质化，是好是坏？
materials.reasoning_chain: 强势文化（美国/西方）输出 → 本地语言/传统/艺术被边缘化 → 文化多样性不可逆地减少
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Dominant cultures (American/Western) export their products → local languages, traditions, and arts are marginalised → cultural diversity irreversibly decreases
materials.example: 全球每两周消亡一种语言（联合国教科文组织数据）；年轻一代不再会说祖辈方言
materials.example_en: A language dies every two weeks worldwide (UNESCO data); younger generations no longer speak their grandparents' dialects
materials.topic_sentence: 文化全球化正在导致本土文化的消亡。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Cultural globalisation is leading to the disappearance of local cultures.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（好）想"个人得到了什么"（选择多=丰富生活、理解多=和平）；反方（坏）想"弱者失去了什么"（本土文化=消亡、本土产业=被挤压）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Dominant Western cultures flood global markets, marginalising local languages, traditions, and arts, which causes cultural diversity to decrease irreversibly.

materials.direction: 全球化导致文化同质化，是好是坏？
materials.reasoning_chain: 好莱坞等强势文化产品以低成本大规模涌入 → 本土影视音乐等产业在竞争中被挤压、失去市场份额 → 本国创作者收入锐减、人才流失，文化产业长期无法壮大
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Dominant cultural products like Hollywood flood in at low cost → local film, TV, and music industries are squeezed and lose market share → domestic creators' incomes plummet, talent drains away, and the cultural industry cannot grow
materials.example: 好莱坞占据全球70%以上电影市场份额，本土电影产业在多数国家难以生存
materials.example_en: Hollywood commands over 70% of the global film market share, making it difficult for domestic film industries to survive in most countries
materials.topic_sentence: 文化全球化严重挤压了发展中国家本土文化产业的生存空间。
materials.topic_sentence_en: Cultural globalisation severely squeezes the survival space of domestic cultural industries in developing countries.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方（好）想"个人得到了什么"（选择多=丰富生活、理解多=和平）；反方（坏）想"弱者失去了什么"（本土文化=消亡、本土产业=被挤压）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When dominant cultural products like Hollywood films flood local markets at low cost, domestic film and music industries are squeezed out, causing creators' incomes to plummet and cultural talent to drain away.

materials.direction: 国际旅游利大于弊吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 旅游业创造大量就业 → 带动酒店/餐饮/交通等产业链 → 对发展中国家尤其是重要收入来源
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Tourism creates massive employment → drives hotel, catering, and transport industries → and is an especially important income source for developing countries
materials.example: 泰国旅游业占GDP约20%，为数百万人提供生计
materials.example_en: Tourism accounts for about 20% of Thailand's GDP and provides livelihoods for millions
materials.topic_sentence: 国际旅游是许多国家重要的经济支柱。
materials.topic_sentence_en: International tourism is a vital economic pillar for many countries.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"旅游带来了什么"（带来钱=经济、带来理解=文化交流）；反方想"旅游破坏了什么"（破坏环境=污染过度开发、破坏文化=商业化表演）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Tourism creates massive employment and drives the hotel, catering, and transport industries, serving as an especially important income source for developing countries.

materials.direction: 国际旅游利大于弊吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 游客亲身体验异国文化 → 促进跨文化理解 → 减少偏见和歧视
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Tourists experience foreign cultures firsthand → promote cross-cultural understanding → reduce prejudice and discrimination
materials.example: 研究显示有国际旅行经验的人对其他文化的包容度显著更高
materials.example_en: Research shows that people with international travel experience are significantly more tolerant of other cultures
materials.topic_sentence: 国际旅游有效促进跨文化理解。
materials.topic_sentence_en: International tourism effectively promotes cross-cultural understanding.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"旅游带来了什么"（带来钱=经济、带来理解=文化交流）；反方想"旅游破坏了什么"（破坏环境=污染过度开发、破坏文化=商业化表演）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When tourists experience foreign cultures firsthand, cross-cultural understanding is promoted, which helps reduce prejudice and discrimination.

materials.direction: 国际旅游利大于弊吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 大量航班碳排放 + 旅游热点过度开发 → 自然环境不堪重负 → 生态系统退化
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Aviation produces massive carbon emissions and tourist hotspots are overdeveloped → the natural environment becomes overwhelmed → local ecosystems degrade
materials.example: 威尼斯/巴厘岛因游客过多导致环境和基础设施严重承压，居民生活质量下降
materials.example_en: Venice and Bali suffer severe environmental and infrastructure strain from overtourism, reducing residents' quality of life
materials.topic_sentence: 国际旅游对自然环境造成严重破坏。
materials.topic_sentence_en: International tourism causes serious damage to the natural environment.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"旅游带来了什么"（带来钱=经济、带来理解=文化交流）；反方想"旅游破坏了什么"（破坏环境=污染过度开发、破坏文化=商业化表演）
materials.chain_sentence_en: Aviation produces massive carbon emissions and tourist hotspots are overdeveloped, overwhelming the natural environment and causing local ecosystems to degrade.

materials.direction: 国际旅游利大于弊吗？
materials.reasoning_chain: 为迎合游客 → 传统文化被简化为表演和纪念品 → 失去真实性和内在价值
materials.reasoning_chain_en: Local communities simplify their traditions to cater to tourists → traditional culture is reduced to performances and souvenirs → losing its authenticity and intrinsic value
materials.example: 巴厘岛的传统宗教仪式原本每年只举办一次，为满足游客需求改为每周表演，当地年轻人已不再理解仪式的宗教含义
materials.example_en: Traditional religious ceremonies in Bali, originally held once a year, are now performed weekly for tourists, and local young people no longer understand their religious significance
materials.topic_sentence: 国际旅游导致传统文化被商业化和庸俗化。
materials.topic_sentence_en: International tourism leads to the commercialisation and trivialisation of traditional cultures.
materials.memory_anchor: 正方想"旅游带来了什么"（带来钱=经济、带来理解=文化交流）；反方想"旅游破坏了什么"（破坏环境=污染过度开发、破坏文化=商业化表演）
materials.chain_sentence_en: When local communities simplify their traditions to cater to tourists, traditional culture is reduced to performances and souvenirs, losing its authenticity and intrinsic value.
